head: ChatGPT Dots email: each Dot may get its own address
dek: OpenAI is testing email addresses for Dots, its always-on agents in ChatGPT: an OpenAI staffer posted on 17 November that Dots will soon have their own address and that testing is starting. TestingCatalog found a hidden Email button in a Dot's profile; there's no release date.
details: The Email button sits next to Call and Slack and opens a settings window that says email isn't available for the account yet, with a "Turn off email" option. The staffer's examples: copy your Dot on a thread to set up a meeting, or forward it a receipt and ask it to negotiate a refund. Today a Dot can only draft or send mail from a Gmail account you connect, and OpenAI's help guide says Dots can't have their own address at launch.
where: In testing at OpenAI; not available to users yet, no date
means: If you use a Dot, it may soon write to people from its own address instead of your personal inbox. Until it arrives, anything it sends goes out from the email account you connected.
todo: Nothing to do yet. If you'd rather a Dot didn't email from your own account, check which accounts you've connected to it.
